Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: HS-410 belongs to PRG-X, an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual replaces revision 3 and requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) for any coating change, plus 90 days' notice. Revision 3 only needed 60 days' notice for a change within the same specification family. DEV-121 only relaxes the zinc-nickel layer thickness, so it does not cover a change to zinc flake. No other document in force gives Aurelia's approval for this change.
